Verb Tenses:
Tempo VerbalEstruturaExemplo
Present SimpleSubject + base verb (he/she/it: verb+s)A few ships cross the Strait of Hormuz every day.
Present ContinuousSubject + am/is/are + Verb-ingA few ships are crossing the Strait of Hormuz right now.
Past SimpleSubject + Verb (Past)A few ships crossed the Strait of Hormuz last month.
Past ContinuousSubject + was/were + Verb-ingA few ships were crossing the Strait of Hormuz when the storm started.
Present PerfectSubject + have/has + Past ParticipleA few ships have crossed the Strait of Hormuz several times this week.
Simple FutureSubject + will + VerbA few ships will cross the Strait of Hormuz tomorrow morning.
Going To FutureSubject + am/is/are going to + VerbA few ships are going to cross the Strait of Hormuz in the next few hours.
